title: Could GTA6 Be Followed by a Boston Setting? Media Explores Massachusetts
description: As GTA6 perfects its Florida satire, gaming media Polygon expresses a strong desire to see Rockstar's potential take on Massachusetts.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Appeal of New England: Looking Beyond GTA6's Florida

As Grand Theft Auto 6 positions itself as a masterclass in Florida satire, the gaming community and media are already letting their imaginations wander about where Rockstar Games might take the franchise next. A recent piece from gaming outlet Polygon has sparked discussions by expressing a strong desire to see Rockstar's unique satirical lens turned toward Massachusetts.

## Why a Boston Setting Could Work

Rockstar has always excelled at capturing the essence of specific American regions, translating their local cultures, social quirks, and political climates into biting satire. From the West Coast vibes of San Andreas and the Hollywood takedowns of Los Santos to the upcoming wild antics of Florida in GTA 6, geography is a core character in every title.

According to Polygon's commentary, the distinct personality, regional accent, historical weight, and urban architecture of Boston and the broader Massachusetts area would provide fertile ground for Rockstar's trademark brand of chaotic, darkly comedic open-world storytelling.

## Editor's Take

While any speculation about post-GTA6 locations remains purely hypothetical, discussions like this highlight the enduring fascination with Rockstar's world-building capabilities. While we eagerly await the chaos of Florida, the idea of a wicked hard Boston adaptation certainly gets the imagination racing.
